summary_md: **Speridlabs ([@speridlabs](https://x.com/speridlabs/status/2115890658636656826))** releases **Idol**, an Apache-2.0 600M-parameter 3D-DiT trained from scratch that generates complete 3D objects from a single image, using under 7.2 GB VRAM and producing 1M Gaussian splats in about 3 seconds ([research page](http://speridlabs.com/research/idol), [weights](https://huggingface.co/speridlabs/idol), [SDK](https://github.com/speridlabs/idol-sdk), [demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/speridlabs/idol)).
